description: Vega 6.4.0's easing functions and interpolateLinear (vega/vega#4316), as a chart uses them: a normalized time mapped to a position. Every one of d3-ease's 37 names is evaluated at eleven times, a string and a time past each end included, and printed in full so a difference in the last digit shows; three are also drawn, and interpolateLinear reads a custom curve. The sine family is printed to fifteen significant digits: easeSinInOut(1.1) is 1 - cos(1.1 pi) over 2, and the JVM's Math.cos intrinsic rounds that one ulp away from V8's fdlibm port, which StrictMath matches. Every other curve is printed in full.

text.signal: datum.curve + ' ' + interpolateLinear([0, 10, 20], datum.t) + ' | ' + easeLinear(datum.t) + ' ' + easeQuad(datum.t) + ' ' + easeQuadIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeQuadOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeQuadInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCubic(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCubicIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCubicOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCubicInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easePoly(datum.t) + ' ' + easePolyIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easePolyOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easePolyInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + format(easeSin(datum.t), '.15') + ' ' + format(easeSinIn(datum.t), '.15') + ' ' + format(easeSinOut(datum.t), '.15') + ' ' + format(easeSinInOut(datum.t), '.15') + ' ' + easeExp(datum.t) + ' ' + easeExpIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeExpOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeExpInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCircle(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCircleIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCircleOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeCircleInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBounce(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBounceIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBounceOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBounceInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBack(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBackIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBackOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeBackInOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeElastic(datum.t) + ' ' + easeElasticIn(datum.t) + ' ' + easeElasticOut(datum.t) + ' ' + easeElasticInOut(datum.t)
